description:
The Newport 7 Drawer Dresser has seven drawers for onesies, sleepers, blankets, and more, in a solid Brown Maple frame.

It measures 56 inches wide, 33 inches high, and 18¾ inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete Newport collection.
title: Newport 7 Drawer Dresser
